qs.q: In the pathological comparison of adrenal neoplasms, which of the following features strongly points toward an adrenal adenoma rather than a carcinoma?
qs.e: Adrenal adenomas are characterized by uniform clear cells, a thin intact capsule, and absence of invasion, whereas carcinomas feature pleomorphism, necrosis, and large size (>100g). A grey-white necrotic appearance and large size are indicative of carcinoma.
